topic: Explain heap sort on the array 4, 10, 3, 5, 1, 8
title: Heap Sort in Place

scenes.narration: Heap sort works in two phases on the same array. First it builds a max heap, where every parent is larger than its children. Then it moves the root, the largest value, to the end, again and again.
scenes.caption: Heapify, then extract the maximum

scenes.narration: Build heap sifts down from the last parent to the root. 3 swaps with 8, then 4 sinks below 10 and 5. The array becomes a max heap and the root is 10.
scenes.caption: build_heap()

scenes.narration: Swap the root 10 with the last value 3, so 10 is in its final place. The heap shrinks by one, and 3 sinks below 8. The root is now 8.
scenes.caption: extract_max(): 10 to the end

scenes.narration: Swap 8 with 1, and 8 joins the sorted part. 1 sinks past 5 and 4, so the root is 5.
scenes.caption: extract_max(): 8 to the end

scenes.narration: Swap 5 with 1. Then 1 sinks below 4, and 4 becomes the root.
scenes.caption: extract_max(): 5 to the end

scenes.narration: Swap 4 with 3. The heap now holds just 3 and 1, and 3 is already larger, so nothing sinks.
scenes.caption: extract_max(): 4 to the end

scenes.narration: One last swap puts 3 in place, leaving 1 at the front. The array reads 1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 10.
scenes.caption: extract_max(): done

scenes.narration: Heap sort never needs a second array and always takes n log n time. The sorted part grew from the back while the heap shrank from the front.
scenes.caption: Summary
points: Build a max heap in O(n)
Swap the root to the end and sift down, n times
O(n log n) always, and O(1) extra space

quiz.question: Heap sort starts on the array 2, 9, 4. After build heap, what is the root?
quiz.explanation: 9 is the largest value, and a max heap keeps it at the root.

quiz.question: Heap sort runs build heap, then one extract max, on 2, 9, 4. What is the array now?
quiz.explanation: 9 swaps to the end; 4 at the root is already larger than 2.
